basisVocabulary.source-explicit: The locked source states the behavior in the cited excerpt.
basisVocabulary.source-inferred: The behavior follows from cited source text but the source does not state it directly. Independent review must confirm the inference before freezing.

basisVocabulary.unobserved-runtime-control: The behavior belongs to the reference host or model at run time and has no captured observation. Its expectation is not known and must be captured from a successful Cursor run before any comparison.

sources.excerpt: If the result is not a detected slug, use the same family's detected slug with the highest effort at or below the target, else mark the role as needing a choice.

So `unlimited` turns `claude-opus-5-5-xhigh` into `claude-opus-5-5-max`. Grok slugs top out at `xhigh`, so under `unlimited` the fallback puts Grok at `xhigh` and keeps `grok-4.7-xhigh-fast` as it is. `large` keeps both defaults. `small` turns them into `claude-opus-5-5-medium` and `grok-4.7-medium-fast`.
`unlimited` lifts each model to its highest tier, up to `max`. Opus goes to `max`. Grok tops out at `xhigh`, so it stays there.
